part.text:
Fixed. The `commandGetKeys` special-case for `eval` in src/server.c:5959 treated `numkeys == 0` as an error (`num < 1` check) and also used `keys_ok = result.numkeys`, so a zero-key EVAL reported "Invalid arguments specified for command". I changed it to:

- reject only `num < 0 || num > available`
- set `keys_ok = 1` on success so zero keys replies with an empty array

Verified: `unit/introspection-2` (including `COMMAND GETKEYS EVAL without keys`), `unit/sort`, `unit/keyspace`, and `unit/moduleapi/getkeys` all pass.
